info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Data Retrieval API enables users to efficiently access detailed information related to various banking channels based on specified parameters. By providing a specific 'param1', users, such as financial analysts and data integrators, can retrieve essential cross-channel insights necessary for informed decision-making and strategic planning. This API is particularly useful for applications that require dynamic data sourcing from multiple banking channels. Use cases include generating reports, enhancing customer insights, and developing cross-channel marketing strategies.
